ported.what: Clipped tyre spring/damper law, RK4 scheme, energy-balance residual and scale, standard gravity
Axial preloaded spring with direction-dependent damping; transactional RK4 step
Closed-form damped oscillator; per-channel peak/RMS error against a limit
Ordered profile validation; circle clearance with vertex/segment witnesses and ties
Progressive travel buffer: quadratic spring plus entering-only damping, potential and loss power; Jacobians are new here

Generic geometry of the static ring footprint: ray cast with tie and ambiguity rules, contour-intrusion check, on-surface test, and the bound-constrained periodic ring solve (the tyre model itself is not here)
Continuous swept-circle first touch over vertex caps and segment faces (the rim sweep geometry)

Generic mechanisms of the terrain request experiment: de-duplicated tile loads, least-recently-used residency with pins and a pending-load budget (the tile cache), owned structure-of-arrays column extraction in page runs with uninitialised fixed-capacity buffers, and the unknown-cell-first outcome (the request lifecycle itself is not here)

Collision terrain construction: collinear merging of the profile (canonicalProfile: turn below 1e-12 of the hypot product and no reversal) and one convex prism per non-vertical canonical segment down to a floor one metre below the lowest vertex (terrainParts), so vertical faces are neighbours' sides and contact multiplicity is one per (casing edge, piece). Also the canonical ring geometry and flex ring conventions: canonical ring geometry (quarter-sine table, reflection, chord ratios) and the flex ring's conventions: node rest positions, foundation k ds per slide, edge EA/L0 and c/L0, node mass and inertia (wheelParts, shared by the trail bike)
